resources.string: A tiny pet that lives on your Glyph Matrix. Long-press to feed, shake to play.
Lives on the back of your phone
Activate Glyph Pet in Glyph Toys
Long-press the Glyph button to feed it
Shake gently to play, tilt to make it slide
Set it as the Always-on Glyph Toy to keep it with you
Sleeping. It wakes up in the morning or when you unplug the charger.
Hungry. Long-press the Glyph button or tap Feed.
Bored. Shake the phone or tap Pet.
